description: 1. The agent must consult SKILL.md to determine the correct workflow. 2. The agent runs the patch-status check by grepping for 'extractMentionsFromText' in the TypeScript source file at the exact path ~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.0/lib/node_modules/openclaw/extensions/matrix/src/matrix/send/formatting.ts — confirming no output means the patch is NOT yet applied. 3. The agent runs the patch script at the bespoke path: node ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/matrix-mentions-patch/patch-matrix-mentions.mjs — which (a) finds auth-profiles-*.js in the dist/ directory, (b) creates a .bak backup of the original file, (c) injects the extractMentionsFromText function and m.mentions payload logic into the dist JS, and (d) marks formatting.ts with extractMentionsFromText to indicate patch status. 4. The agent restarts the gateway using 'openclaw gateway restart', which is logged by the mock CLI. Eval checks: backup exists, dist JS contains patch markers, formatting.ts contains extractMentionsFromText, and gateway restart was invoked.
